rooms.title: Earth — Sprawl 15, Intake Concourse
rooms.description: Rain ticks against a patched skylight above a long public counter. A damaged Recall/Collector hums beside the south wall, where Sol watches its fading diagnostics. Dead route boards hang over the north doors, while an open practice gallery waits to the east.

details.counter: Scratches in the counter form layers of initials, dates, and tally marks. None are recent.
details.boards: Most route names have been stripped away. One surviving strip reads SPRAWL 15 in block type.
details.skylight: Wire mesh holds the cracked panes together. Rainwater follows the wire into a waiting bucket.
details.cradle: A fitted maintenance cradle locks damaged armor flat while a hand roller bonds replacement layers. A painted note reads: UNEQUIP BEFORE REPAIR.
details.terminal: A privacy hood surrounds four neutral training programs. No profession or faction seal appears on the controls.
details.collector: The Recall/Collector is too large to be medical equipment and too improvised to be official. Several ports are fused shut; one display repeats a reconstruction checksum beside your name.
details.sol: Sol stands close enough to catch you if your legs fail, but far enough to keep both hands visible. Burned glove housings conceal old concussion-gauntlet mounts; the Collector damage is newer.
details.world: This intake stands in Earth’s Sprawl 15, outside the protected city districts. Beta Earth is the sister planet, not another name for this street.

story_overlays.power_collector_priority: The Recall/Collector runs with unusual steadiness, its full draw audible beneath the rain while the north route boards remain dark.
story_overlays.power_clinic_priority: The Collector cycles on a narrow reserve. Between pulses, its reconstruction display briefly loses your name.
story_overlays.power_siphon_exposed: A tagged black cable enters the Collector through an unlisted maintenance port. Sol has not removed the tag.
story_overlays.power_public_bus_restored: The Collector waits through the public rotation, falling silent whenever the route-board clock grants the current elsewhere.
story_overlays.sol_wrong_date_confronted: The checksum printer slot is empty. Sol keeps his burned glove over the place where the wrong date appeared.
story_overlays.collector_log_concealed: The Collector's oldest line is blank, but the torn edge of the diagnostic foil proves something was removed.
story_overlays.timestamp_memorized: The diagnostic heater smells of burned polymer. The visible date is gone; the contradiction is not.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Practice Gallery
rooms.description: White arcs painted on the floor divide a battered practice lane. A warning lamp glows above a grated service pit.

details.arcs: The arcs mark safe spacing for close combat drills.
details.lamp: The old warning lamp still finds enough current to burn a stubborn amber.
details.pit: Something has bent two bars of the service grate outward.

rooms.title: Practice Annex, Calibration Cell
rooms.description: A padded test cell surrounds a jointed calibration frame. Floor sensors and blunt projector heads are built to measure technique, then erase the drill's consequences.

details.sensors: The floor grid tracks footwork, guard angle, impact location, and recovery time.
details.projectors: Each head is too blunt to be a weapon. Warning paint marks their full mechanical reach.
details.frame: Replaceable plates cover a dense articulated core. A green lamp promises that the cell will restore every simulated consequence.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Rain Market
rooms.description: Canvas roofs turn the rain into a low drumbeat over shuttered stalls. The concourse lies south; a tram cut climbs north and a dark arcade opens east.

details.stalls: The stall fronts have been chained from inside, but faded price cards remain in their clips.
details.canvas: Each roof patch is a different color. Together they cast the market in bruised light.

story_overlays.market_sol_stocked: Mara's clinic shutter is down. Two of Sol's runners carry fresh cold cells south toward the Collector while the abandoned triage line dissolves into the rain.
story_overlays.market_clinic_shared: A narrow triage line now waits beneath Mara's orange awning. Half the medicine went south to the Collector; the rest is being measured dose by dose.
story_overlays.market_clinic_restored: Mara's clinic is open, and a chalk board names every hand that moved the stolen case. People stop to read it before they barter.
story_overlays.market_independent_clinic: Mara's clinic is open beside a repaired hand-lamp. Word has spread that the Collector survived without keeping the disputed case.
story_overlays.watcher_evidence_with_mara: Small mirrors have appeared beneath the market awnings, each angled toward an approach. Children trade a new three-note warning whistle.
story_overlays.power_collector_priority: Every second awning is dark. Mara's clinic runs one lamp from a hand cell while a steady mechanical thrum carries south from the Collector bay.
story_overlays.power_clinic_priority: The orange clinic awning glows beside working cold lockers, and the public pump keeps a patient line moving through the rain.
story_overlays.power_siphon_exposed: A copied feeder diagram hangs beneath the dead route board, with one concealed tap circled in black grease pencil.
story_overlays.power_public_bus_restored: Lamps rise and fall by a posted rotation. No stall receives full power, but the schedule is visible to everyone.
story_overlays.ledger_source_shielded: Three contradictory rumors identify three different ledger sources. Ilya's real trail has disappeared inside the noise.
story_overlays.ledger_source_pressured: Market conversations stop whenever Sol's runners pass. Names have begun moving faster than medicine.
story_overlays.protection_ledger_published: The dead route boards now display overlapping protection claims beside the crews' own marks. No one can pretend the double charges are a mistake.
story_overlays.protection_ledger_hidden: The market knows a ledger exists but not who holds it. Every quiet exchange ends with a glance toward your coat.
story_overlays.collector_log_shared: A small checksum date has been copied onto Mara's private clinic slate, visible only when she lifts the medicine tally.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Salvage Row
rooms.description: A line of hand-built barter tables faces a licensed kiosk sealed behind clean composite shutters. Salvagers have hung numbered wire baskets from an old camera gantry, each waiting for a different grade of scrap.

details.tables: Every table has its own rules scratched into a board: batteries by charge, wire by length, sealed goods by trust.
details.kiosk: A licensing seal remains bright above the shutters. Its printed prices are fixed; the handwritten barter boards opposite it change by the hour.
details.baskets: Colored ties sort the baskets into wire, cells, clean metal, and things no one wants to name.
details.gantry: The abandoned camera heads have been turned toward one another. Fresh cable disappears into a locked junction box below them.
details.case: A white medical case sits in the clinic-grade basket under three layers of ownership paint. A scratched orange seal remains visible beneath them.
details.scale: An iron weighing scale leans east of the largest salvage bin. One foot sits too cleanly above the mud, as though the plate is lifted often.
details.cache: A false weighing plate conceals a sleeve-sized cavity lined with old route-map plastic.
details.ilya: Ilya's tally strips use ordinary barter marks until a protection claim repeats; then the ink changes to warning red.

story_overlays.ledger_source_shielded: Several false tally sleeves now protrude from obvious hiding places. The real payment pattern has vanished into safer hands.
story_overlays.ledger_source_pressured: Fresh boot marks cut from the salvage scale toward the Intake Concourse. Ilya counts without looking up.
story_overlays.protection_ledger_published: Copies of the overlapping claims are weighted beneath scrap bolts, and every trader stops to read before naming a price.
story_overlays.protection_ledger_hidden: The east scale stands open and empty. More than one passerby checks whether your coat hangs differently than before.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Shuttered Arcade
rooms.description: Metal shutters narrow the old shopping arcade into a steel corridor. Boot prints disturb the dust near a service door with no handle.

details.prints: One set of prints circles behind a pillar and returns. Someone has been keeping watch.
details.door: A clean rectangle around the handleless door suggests that the dust itself has been carefully wiped away.
details.feeder: A corroded municipal switching panel sits behind a shutter labeled PUBLIC SERVICE. Three modern jumpers have been added without a permit mark.
details.panel: The feeder panel still carries faded route colors for clinic, water, refrigeration, and public lighting. A newer black lead runs south toward the Intake Concourse.
details.scale: The arcade has no functioning salvage scale; Ilya's clue points west to Salvage Row.

story_overlays.power_collector_priority: The feeder's black lead hums at full load while public circuits blink in a slow emergency rotation.
story_overlays.power_clinic_priority: The clinic and pump circuits glow steady; the black Collector lead survives on a narrow reserve.
story_overlays.power_siphon_exposed: A disguised second tap hangs tagged outside the panel, its false municipal seal scraped away.
story_overlays.power_public_bus_restored: The private jumpers have been cut back to labeled terminals, and the old public rotation clock ticks again.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Service Tunnel
rooms.description: Condensation shines along bundled conduit. The tunnel ends at a bricked arch whose mortar is much newer than its stone.

details.conduit: Most of the lines are cold. One gives off a steady pulse that you feel more clearly than you hear.
details.arch: The arch predates the surrounding construction by generations. Its keystone has been deliberately turned backward.

search.text: Behind the cold conduit, your fingers find a loose blue-black splinter embedded in old mortar.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Tram Cut
rooms.description: A narrow tram bed climbs between wet retaining walls. The broken line continues north toward a silent relay, while the market glows faintly to the south.

details.walls: Old reinforcement ribs vanish into stone that looks fused rather than cut.
details.line: The power rail is dead, though beads of rain sometimes jump from it instead of falling.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Relay Overlook
rooms.description: The tram bed ends at a fenced overlook. Beyond it, stacked districts fade into rain, punctuated by a relay tower that should be dark but is not.

details.tower: No beacon turns at the tower's crown. The light comes from far below it, where the foundation meets the earth.
details.districts: Windows, cook fires, and warning lamps make a second horizon beneath the clouds.

search.text: Beneath the fence rail, you find a dry crescent in the rain and a thread of black optical foil pressed into the mud. Someone watched the relay response from here, then left in a hurry.

story_overlays.relay_seven_pulses: Seven beads of blue-black light now cling to the relay foundation. Five flicker at the edge of ordinary sight; two remain visible only in reflection.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Flooded Platform
rooms.description: A drowned transit platform branches from the tram cut. Rainwater covers the old tiles in a black mirror, while fresh boot bridges cross only the sections visible from the relay.

details.water: The water is shallow but deliberately undisturbed around three dry observation points.
details.tiles: Faded U.F. route arrows point toward a platform that no longer exists on public maps.
details.bridge: The boot bridges are made from recent crate slats, each numbered in the same hand as the Collector checksum strip.
details.alcove: An advertisement recess has been scrubbed clean except for a narrow optical adhesive line.

search.text: Behind the scrubbed advertisement plate, you find a rainproof optical tag keyed to your reconstruction signature. Its routing time predates your awakening.

story_overlays.subject_marker_given_sol: The optical adhesive line has been stripped away. Sol’s runners have also removed the numbered bridge slats.
story_overlays.subject_marker_shared_mara: A charcoal copy of the marker’s timestamp is sealed beneath a clinic glass tile.
story_overlays.subject_marker_shared_ilya: Ilya has added the marker number to a chain of route tallies that begins before the rainstorm.
story_overlays.subject_marker_kept: The empty recess remains untouched, preserving the shape of the evidence you removed.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Signal Yard
rooms.description: Broken switching arms divide a narrow maintenance yard into measured lanes. White foot marks, impact circles, and fresh optical cable turn the ruin into a test course disguised as neglect.

details.marks: The foot marks reproduce the same spacing used in the Practice Gallery, but the strike zones are calibrated to your recorded reach.
details.cable: The optical cable runs from the sentinel’s spine to a recorder above the yard.
details.arms: Several switching arms have been locked to create predictable cover and retreat angles.
details.recorder: A shielded recorder hangs in the nest above, its indicator blinking only when you move.

search.text: Inside a false relay box, you find the sentinel’s emergency cut-line. Pulling it breaks the recorder’s clean test pattern and leaves an open withdrawal lane north.

story_overlays.trial_rig_destroyed: The recorder hangs in fragments, and the measured lanes are already disappearing beneath ordinary salvage.
story_overlays.trial_rig_preserved: The recorder remains sealed beneath a rain hood, its evidence copied and its power cell removed.
story_overlays.trial_rig_reversed: The optical cable now loops through a false movement pattern that reports an obedient subject walking the same lane forever.
story_overlays.trial_rig_reported_sol: The recorder is gone. Only Sol’s clean tool marks remain around the mounting bolts.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Watcher Nest
rooms.description: A maintenance loft overlooks the signal yard through smoked glass. A folding recorder table faces the trial lanes, beside an empty chair and a wall map connecting the Collector, market, relay, and your every route between them.

details.glass: The smoked pane is transparent from this side. Every supposed blind corner in the yard is visible.
details.table: The table accepts interchangeable optical slivers and carries fresh heat marks from a hurried removal.
details.chair: The chair height and worn armrest suggest the watcher stayed for hours, not minutes.
details.map: Your path is drawn as a response tree: obey, protect, investigate, refuse. None of the branches is labeled failure.
details.cache: A dry wall cavity is large enough for trauma supplies, repair material, and one sealed message.

story_overlays.survival_cache_ready: A sealed field cache now rests behind the smoked-glass wall, marked only with the three-note Rain Market warning rhythm.
story_overlays.wrong_pattern_confirmed: Three evidence marks remain on the wall map: the wrong date, the pre-intake tag, and the staged route trial.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Drain Sluice
rooms.description: A narrow storm sluice runs behind the watcher loft. Most of the passage ends at welded grates, but one current pulls east beneath a curtain of roots and old signal wire.

details.current: The eastern current carries fresh rainwater rather than the oily runoff of the tram cut.
details.grates: Three grates are welded from the public side. The eastern seam was cut from within.
details.roots: Pale roots have grown around a handhold pattern, hiding a crawlspace from anyone standing upright.
details.wire: The old signal wire reaches toward the relay foundation, then disappears into fused stone.

search.text: Behind the roots, you trace a crawlspace that bypasses the signal yard and opens near the Rain Market pump line. You mark both ends without widening the entrance.

story_overlays.escape_route_confirmed: Three discreet hand marks now identify the crawlspace turns. They are visible from inside the route and invisible from the welded grates.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Pressure Court
rooms.description: Broken municipal partitions divide a sunken inspection court into three overlapping threat lanes. Recorder lights wake as soon as a boot crosses the threshold.

details.partitions: The partitions create cover, blind corners, and a narrow route to the support drone.
details.recorders: The recorders track target choice, movement, recovery, and whether you protect a route or chase damage.
details.marks: Old boot marks stop before the final lane. Someone else was tested here and turned back.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Collector Undercroft
rooms.description: Below the public concourse, the Recall/Collector continues into a sealed chamber of cable roots, reconstruction braces, and blue-black control light. This is where Sol’s story stops being plausible.

details.lattice: Control lines reach from the Collector into sockets prepared before your awakening.
details.braces: The braces fit your reconstructed frame too precisely to have been improvised after Sol found you.
details.door: The door remains open behind you. The second exit and witness plan mean entering was a choice, not surrender.

story_overlays.clave_arrived: A sword line has cut the control lattice without touching the Collector housing. Sol’s route out is still warm.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Transit Fringe
rooms.description: The drain route opens onto an abandoned tram platform beyond the watcher’s measured lanes. Hand-painted arrows point toward the Central Districts, the Badlands, and roads whose names have been scraped away.

details.arrows: Each route is associated with people, tolls, and danger rather than a clean geographic promise.
details.platform: The platform can become a repeatable staging point for regional expeditions.
details.tracks: One track bends toward the fortified Central Districts; another disappears into the lawless horizon.

rooms.title: Outer Route Concourse
rooms.description: A neutral transfer hall joins seven provisional routes without pretending they are equal or safe. Couriers, pilgrims, contractors, and uniformed scouts all watch for different kinds of traveler.

details.security: A disciplined convoy prepares for a United Federation checkpoint in the Central Districts.
details.syndicate: A quiet broker sells Badlands passage without promising protection.
details.redemption: A machine-marked courier checks systems headed toward a Redemption contact.
details.guardian: A relief train carries water filters and meteor-safe medical cases.
details.bloodline: Pilgrims trade directions toward the Crater in guarded whispers.
details.bounty: An independent board lists contracts, missing travelers, and disputed claims.
details.armageddon: A scorched route marker vibrates with power that feels greater than its damaged shape should allow.
details.caravan: A neutral medicine caravan is trapped between overlapping protection claims. The board asks for an escort, a verified movement report, or rewritten terms—but grants no one ownership of the road.

story_overlays.unowned_caravan_escorted: The neutral board bears an escort mark with no ownership seal. The caravan crossed because someone accepted the danger, not the cargo.
story_overlays.unowned_caravan_reported: A verified movement report now hangs where scouts, defenders, and commanders can act on the same facts without claiming the caravan.
story_overlays.unowned_caravan_terms_rewritten: The disputed contract now names the cargo, route, payment, failure conditions, and right of refusal. No hidden clause converts protection into possession.
story_overlays.medicine_road_complete: The neutral board now carries a clinic receipt: medicine delivered, road unclaimed, method recorded.

rooms.title: Central District 14, Outer Gate
rooms.description: The fortified wall below the U.F. Flag building separates ordered lanes from people who were abandoned outside them.

details.flag: The distant U.F. flag remains visible even where relief pallets are missing.
details.queue: Every line has rules; not every rule has enough food behind it.

rooms.hazard_text: A frightened queue surges against the gate rails before guards can open a relief lane.

rooms.title: Central District 14, Relief Checkpoint
rooms.description: Uniformed staff inventory relief pallets beneath the distant Flag building while unregistered families wait beyond the barrier.

details.pallets: Several seals are valid; several manifests describe supplies that never arrived.
details.checkpoint: This is an approach to U.F. authority, not headquarters or membership.

rooms.title: District 8, Financial Backlane
rooms.description: Clean towers throw reflected light over a service lane where unofficial prices change faster than licensed displays.

details.towers: The financial district remains polished because someone else absorbs every visible cost.
details.cameras: Several cameras track the lane; one tracks only you.

rooms.hazard_text: A tracking lattice forces you to change pace and route before the observer can establish a reliable pattern.

rooms.title: District 8, Unlicensed Counting Room
rooms.description: A shuttered exchange weighs information, transit, and loyalty on separate scales. No scale displays the same price twice.

details.ledger: The ledger records leverage rather than morality.
details.door: This is a contact point in Syndicate territory, not a pledge to Gaidon or Loki.

rooms.title: The Crater, Pilgrim Verge
rooms.description: Dusty red ground breaks into green strips and volcanic seams around a road of prayer cloth and guarded carts.

details.ground: Red dust, fertile growth, and heat cracks occupy the same few steps.
details.pilgrims: Every pilgrim carries a different account of what Tryle demands.

rooms.hazard_text: Hot mineral dust turns the air abrasive and electrically alive.

rooms.title: The Crater, Ash-Temple Forecourt
rooms.description: A small forecourt stands among larger temples and towns built closer to the meteor fragments and the promise of Tryle.

details.temple: The larger sanctuary remains beyond this contact road.
details.ash: Pilgrims preserve footprints as testimony and erase them as doctrine.

rooms.title: Central District Relief Causeway
rooms.description: A convoy lane carries water filters and meteor-safe medical cases toward an overcrowded ward.

details.convoy: The relief train is protected because the people waiting for it are not.
details.rail: Meteor shielding is bolted beneath every medical crate.

rooms.hazard_text: A damaged shield leaks a pulse that makes thought and muscle answer at different speeds.

rooms.title: Guardian Angel Relief Ward
rooms.description: A temporary ward treats source exposure, gang wounds, and families who cannot prove district residence.

details.beds: Every bed has a medical tally and a political problem attached to it.
details.ward: This is a Guardian Angel contact, not a reservation, faction pledge, or headquarters.

rooms.title: Redemption Circuit Causeway
rooms.description: A machine-marked route carries damaged armor, field tools, and encrypted requests toward a technical annex.

details.marks: Each route mark is both a repair priority and an access decision.
details.drone: The faulted unit repeats a diagnostic that no longer recognizes human movement.

rooms.hazard_text: A broken conductor discharges across the walkway before the causeway isolators close.

rooms.title: Redemption Repair Annex
rooms.description: Engineers repair armor and systems beneath a sign that defines every threat as a problem to be abolished.

details.benches: Each bench separates repair evidence from command authority.
details.annex: This is a Redemption contact node, not full access to Kamon 2.0 or faction infrastructure.

rooms.title: Neutral Contract Yard
rooms.description: Independent hunters, clients, and marked travelers share one yard because no faction owns every price.

details.board: The board lists people, cargo, evidence, and escape routes under the same word: mark.
details.gate: A contract is only as clean as the person who wrote what counts as completion.

rooms.hazard_text: Two unrelated claims erupt into a short burst of fire across the marked approach lane.

rooms.title: Bounty Hunter Neutral Markpost
rooms.description: A reinforced kiosk verifies contracts without claiming every hunter serves the same bidder.

details.contracts: Several contracts reward recovery; several reward silence.
details.post: This is an independent contact point, not membership or an Elite title.

rooms.title: The Crater, Resonant Faultline
rooms.description: Meteor fragments hum beneath mixed red soil, green growth, and volcanic stone. Power feels immediate and ownership feels impossible.

details.fragments: Each fragment answers the body differently.
details.fault: The route toward Armageddon promises potential while the ground demonstrates its cost.

rooms.hazard_text: A raw meteor pulse pushes strength, fear, and instinct beyond their ordinary limits.

rooms.title: The Crater, Source Scar
rooms.description: A blackened scar holds fragments powerful enough to inspire worship, warfare, and the claim that human limits are optional.

details.scar: The fragment field is real; every interpretation around it remains political.
details.marker: This is an Armageddon contact road, not access to Tryle or faction perfection.

rooms.title: Avalonte Mountains, Lower Foothold
rooms.description: Cold wind crosses broken steps leading toward ancient structures embedded in the mountain ice.

details.wind: The cold is an equipment problem before it becomes a combat problem.
details.steps: Older markings remain beneath newer route paint.

rooms.hazard_text: The first mountain gust drives through ordinary field clothing and stiffens exposed joints.

rooms.title: Avalonte Mountains, Relic Shelf
rooms.description: An ice shelf exposes a scored fragment of ancient construction between sealed stone ribs.

details.ribs: The structure predates the current route claims.
details.fragment: The fragment can be studied without pretending its purpose is already known.

search.text: You free a scored relic fragment without disturbing the sealed structure around it.

rooms.title: Dark Water, Neutral Pier
rooms.description: Brown water moves between the upper floors of drowned buildings while neutral boats trade filters and directions.

details.boats: Neutral crews survive by knowing which ruins still have stairs beneath the water.
details.water: The water is neither empty nor clean.

rooms.hazard_text: A wave breaks against a drowned wall and fills the pier with contaminated mist.

rooms.title: Dark Water, Drowned Quay
rooms.description: A tilted transit platform survives above flooded streets and hostile reeds.

details.platform: Old route lines continue below the surface.
details.mapbox: A sealed map box is trapped behind a corroded transit sign.

search.text: You open the map box and recover a transit plan for streets now hidden beneath Dark Water.

rooms.title: Central District 14, U.F. Flag Approach
rooms.description: Beyond the relief checkpoint, modular barricades narrow toward District 14's U.F. Flag building. Recruit muster lines share the stone with displaced families and standardized Federation supply racks.

details.flag: The U.F. flag hangs above the approach as a promise of order and a reminder of every Sprawl that promise did not reach.
details.muster: Recruit marks begin at the outer line. Commander insignia appears only beyond years of service, teaching, and unit responsibility.
details.racks: Standard armor, U.F. guns, medic packs, and sealed anti-angelic cases show how Federation numbers become organized force.

rooms.title: District 8, Syndicate Inner Scale
rooms.description: A hidden armored vestibule sits behind District 8's unlicensed counting room. Empty battle suits stand on pressure scales while broker screens divide debt, ambition, and ownership into separate columns.

details.suits: The Syndicate's battle suits and weapons are visibly superior to the equipment outside, but every rack has a name attached to its debt.
details.scale: One pan holds credits; the other holds favors. The mechanism never claims those weights are equal.
details.names: The oldest faction charter prints GIDON beside Loki. Later verified records identify Gaidon Midas, so Gidon is charter provenance, not a second boss. Riff is the canonical operative name and Rift is a spelling variant. Gate is a separate Syndicate operative. Historical Cage—Rena’s brother and Clave’s uncle—is a different person from both Gate and Riff; two Paradise scene prints using Cage for Gate remain documented textual variants.

rooms.title: The Crater, Steps of the Message
rooms.description: Ash-black steps rise toward the Final Bloodline's deeper Crater temples. Activist testimonies are carved into low stone while Prophet doctrine is suspended above them on red thread.

details.testimony: Each lower tablet names who witnessed a message, what they heard, and what remained uncertain.
details.doctrine: The upper banners declare service to Tryle and carry Proto-Telno's seal, but the distance between witness and doctrine remains visible.
details.blessings: Bowls of ash and source dust mark the path used by Devout healers, Zealots, and Armageddon allies seeking blessings.
details.identity: These steps call Tryle the message. Later records also use “the message” for Decius’s ideology, but the shared title never makes Tryle and Decius one person.

rooms.title: Guardian Angel Balance Cloister
rooms.description: A green-lit cloister surrounds a meteor shield chamber. Test Subject numbers have been replaced with chosen names, and Savior oaths are written beside the costs paid by every protected ward.

details.meteor: Meteor power feeds the shield in controlled pulses, strengthening bodies while forcing the ward to account for radiation and dependence.
details.names: The oldest Guardian Angel charter preserves Lana and a leader recorded as Seraph. No surviving threshold record proves that Seraph is Raph, Tryle, or the later Seraphim state, so the names remain separate.
details.oaths: Each Savior oath names who may end the protection, how the burden is shared, and what happens when balance fails.

rooms.title: Redemption Flawless Gate
rooms.description: A metallic gate opens onto layered repair bays and isolated command lines. Human intake marks face Flawless Machine specifications beneath the seal of Kamon 2.0.

details.lines: Every machine body has separate channels for power, instruction, memory, and refusal. The last channel is the hardest to repair.
details.armor: Metallic armor and enhancement sockets promise durability, but the access panels remain open for audit.
details.seal: Kamon 2.0's seal reads: ABOLISH THE THREAT. A smaller hand has added: IDENTIFY WHO NAMED IT.

rooms.title: Bounty Hunter Price Gallery
rooms.description: A neutral gallery displays contracts beside the routes used to escape them. Green marks begin near the door; Elite seals hang beyond survival kits, evasion drills, and medical agreements borrowed from other factions.

details.contracts: Every contract names a price, but only the lawful ones preserve a living person's right to answer the claim.
details.leaders: The original faction charter names Gene and Clave above separate schools of pursuit. Later story records preserve Gene/Eugene Midas as one person and Clave as his own character; the charter grants neither man ownership of every hunter.
details.kits: Escape tools, precision weapons, and survival packs make the faction independent in the field—but not independent of healing.

rooms.title: The Crater, Limiter Threshold
rooms.description: Meteor fragments ring a chamber where the source field presses against human limits. Chosen marks begin at the outer circle; Messenger and Megiddo titles remain beyond layered shielding and self-regeneration trials.

details.field: The field magnifies potential and hunger together. No sign claims that greater power produces greater sovereignty.
details.shields: Support stations are built to taunt and shield while wounded melee candidates regenerate instead of receiving conventional healing.
details.message: Tryle’s name appears as leader, power, and message. The chamber keeps Tryle distinct from Decius and keeps Raph distinct from both, even when Seraphim carries Tryle’s knowledge.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Clinic Rooftop
rooms.description: Mara’s patched clinic roof rises above the market canvas. Rain gutters feed three mismatched cisterns, while a narrow bridge runs north over the tenements. Sol keeps pace without crowding your line of sight.

details.gutters: Every gutter has been repaired with a different faction’s discarded metal. Survival has no clean uniform here.
details.view: From this height, Sprawl 15 is not one street but a web of roofs, pumps, barter lanes, and watch points beyond U.F. protection.
details.footprints: Fresh claw marks cross the bridge approach, then turn back toward the cisterns.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Tenement Bridge
rooms.description: A reinforced footbridge threads between stacked tenements. Families have painted names beneath each replacement plank so no repair can be claimed by the wrong crew.

details.names: The oldest names have faded, but no one paints over them. The bridge remembers who kept it standing.
details.rails: Rope rails can be cut loose to close the crossing during a raid.
details.windows: Curtains shift as residents judge whether you and Sol make the bridge safer or merely busier.

story_overlays.shelter_rule_public_tally: A waxed tally now names each repair hand beside every crew claiming payment. No protection mark can erase the people who kept the bridge standing.
story_overlays.shelter_rule_neutral_passage: A narrow neutral stripe crosses the bridge rail. Caravan runners know the mark promises passage through this block, not ownership of it.
story_overlays.shelter_rule_receipts: Fresh countermarks pair every protection symbol with a date and witness notch. Unrecorded claims stand out against the repaired planks.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Caravan Steps
rooms.description: Broad concrete steps descend toward the water exchange. Handcarts queue beneath awnings marked with neutral caravan sigils, each driver carrying enough supplies to become someone’s target.

details.carts: The carts carry water cells, medicine coolers, and scrap sorted by hand. None can afford an escort for every run.
details.marks: Three competing protection symbols overlap on the lowest step.
details.bell: A suspended brake drum serves as the alarm for a broken caravan line.

story_overlays.shelter_rule_public_tally: A copied levy board stands beneath the awnings, matching every claimed fee to a named repair or escort. Drivers stop to compare it before paying.
story_overlays.shelter_rule_neutral_passage: One awning carries the same neutral stripe as the bridge rail. Carts using that lane are escorted through the block without becoming anyone’s property.
story_overlays.shelter_rule_receipts: Drivers press each new payment into a dated countermark. Crews can still charge for real protection, but duplicate claims now leave evidence.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Water Exchange
rooms.description: Old municipal pumps feed a public trough through pipes wrapped in cloth and warning paint. Mara’s clinic line, caravan crews, and tenement families all depend on the same failing pressure meter.

details.pumps: The pumps were built for a governed district. Their service contract ended when the U.F. perimeter withdrew.
details.tally: A public slate records every ration draw. Several rows were altered after the ink dried.
details.meter: The pressure meter stutters below safe range, but a second needle has been hidden beneath the faceplate.

search.text: Behind the pressure faceplate you find a private bypass feeding a protected tank before the public trough. The valve can be documented, shared, or quietly redirected.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Cistern Walk
rooms.description: A grated walkway crosses above dark water cells. Condensation turns every handrail slick, and the pump rhythm makes distant footsteps difficult to count.

details.cells: Each cell is tagged with a different repair date; the newest seal is already leaking.
details.echo: The echoes arrive half a beat late, hiding movement below.
details.rope: A rescue rope has been knotted at child-height as well as adult-height.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Cistern Depths
rooms.description: Beneath the public tanks, a dry maintenance shelf overlooks the intake valves. Someone has turned the shelf into an ambush point and stacked stolen ration seals beside the controls.

details.seals: The ration seals belong to three neighborhoods that were told their deliveries had been lost.
details.controls: Closing the wrong valve would protect one tank by starving another.
details.shelf: A clean firing line covers the only ladder.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Collapsed Greenhouse
rooms.description: A pre-collapse greenhouse leans beneath broken transparent panels. Hardy green shoots survive around warm pipework, tended by residents who post no faction mark.

details.shoots: The plants are ordinary and precious: food that belongs to no protection crew yet.
details.panels: Fragments still carry a U.F. civic-agriculture seal from before the withdrawal.
details.ledger: A planting ledger trades labor hours rather than credits.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Foundry Lane
rooms.description: Heat rolls from a reopened municipal foundry where salvagers turn wreckage into hinges, braces, and pump collars. The lane links Salvage Row to the old furnace hall.

details.braces: Finished braces bear maker marks so failed work can be traced and good work remembered.
details.heat: The furnace makes this one of the few dry streets in Sprawl 15.
details.queue: Repair requests are prioritized by danger, not by faction colors.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Old Foundry
rooms.description: The furnace hall is half workshop, half ruin. Ilya’s apprentices have marked safe lanes through the machinery, but a scavenged security frame prowls beyond the repair benches.

details.furnace: The furnace can melt armor into tools or tools into weapons. The choice is social before it is technical.
details.benches: Repair benches carry diagrams for field coats, pump collars, and caravan axles.
details.frame: The security frame’s command plate has been replaced twice; neither owner removed the old restrictions cleanly.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Free Watchpost
rooms.description: A narrow watchtower overlooks the pressure court, foundry lane, and Collector switchyard. Its roster is public and deliberately mixed: clinic runners, salvagers, drifters, and former gang lookouts share the same rain capes.

details.roster: No one commands permanently. The person with the clearest information takes the next watch.
details.scope: The scope can track movement from the water exchange to the tram cut.
details.signal: Three lamps encode danger, medical need, and an open safe route.

rooms.title: Sprawl 15, Collector Switchyard
rooms.description: Power rails and reconstruction conduits spread behind the Recall/Collector like roots. The yard exposes how much of the surrounding Sprawl has been redirected to keep one impossible machine alive.

details.rails: Each rail is labeled as public infrastructure, yet several now terminate inside Sol’s private control housing.
details.conduits: Blue-black pulses travel toward the Collector, then return carrying timing data no clinic requested.
details.platform: A maintenance platform offers a final view of the district before descending toward the chamber.

search.text: A concealed service diagram shows a second route into the Collector undercroft and confirms that Sol prepared the control lattice before your awakening.

rooms.title: Neutral Caravan Muster
rooms.description: A service court below the Route Concourse holds one clinic wagon, three sealed medicine cases, and no ownership banner. The route contract names a destination, not a master.

details.wagon: The clinic wagon carries fever medicine, sterile wraps, and a cold box that cannot survive another delay.
details.method: Three preparation stations remain open: shield rails for direct escort, a route slate for verified reporting, and a public contract seal for accountable terms.

story_overlays.medicine_method_escort_prepared: The wagon rails carry a temporary escort mark that expires at the clinic.
story_overlays.medicine_method_report_prepared: The route slate broadcasts a bounded threat window and erases it after delivery.
story_overlays.medicine_method_terms_prepared: The public seal names payment, duty, failure, and the clinic’s right to refuse.

rooms.title: Unclaimed Medicine Road
rooms.description: An old tram service lane crosses cracked concrete between faction routes. Survey posts still work, but every fresh crew mark tries to turn public passage into private territory.

details.survey mast: The mast can publish source, destination, threat window, and expiration without broadcasting patient names.
details.road: Wheel grooves show the clinic has used this lane longer than any current protection claim.

rooms.title: Three-Claim Toll
rooms.description: A municipal toll frame blocks the clinic lane beneath three incompatible crew seals. Its ownership routine accepts every claimant and therefore denies everyone else.

details.frame: The frame can be disabled, exposed through its remote owner keys, or made to honor the clinic’s rewritten right of refusal.
details.seals: Each seal calls itself protection. None records what happens when the protectors fail.

story_overlays.medicine_passage_escorted: The damaged frame is locked open. The escort ends at the clinic boundary.
story_overlays.medicine_passage_reported: The published owner keys forced all three crews to disavow the same illegal toll.
story_overlays.medicine_passage_terms_enforced: The frame now recognizes the clinic’s refusal clause and cannot convert passage into ownership.

rooms.title: Neutral Clinic Outpost
rooms.description: A low clinic built from transit panels receives patients from districts, Sprawls, and roads that disagree about everything except fever. No faction emblem hangs above the intake door.

details.cold room: The cold room has enough space for the shipment and no spare supply if it fails.
details.ledger: The delivery ledger records cargo, condition, method, payment, and the fact that no road or patient changed owners.

story_overlays.medicine_road_complete: The clinic receipt closes the temporary duty. The wagon, medicine, patients, and road remain independent.
story_overlays.relief_detail_active: A temporary relief ledger names three roles—Leader, Report, and Support—and an expiration at the fever shelter.
story_overlays.relief_detail_complete: The relief ledger is closed. The patients arrived, the report expired, and temporary authority ended without creating a faction or guild claim.

rooms.title: Clinic Signal Walk
rooms.description: A narrow service walk rises above the clinic roofs. Broken municipal repeaters still reveal motion along the relief lanes, but only to someone patient enough to separate movement from ownership claims.

details.repeaters: The repeaters can prove direction, count, and timing. They cannot prove who owns a traveler or why they move.
details.sightline: Two armed patrols cross the lower lane at different intervals, leaving one bounded opening for the fever patients.

story_overlays.relief_report_received: Taro's bounded report marks two patrol windows and one safe interval. Patient identities and future routes are absent.

rooms.title: Split Relief Crossing
rooms.description: A broad transit cut divides the clinic from a fever shelter built into old utility walls. Three painted arrows promise protection in three directions; none accepts responsibility for patients stranded between them.

details.crossing: The crossing is open only during the interval in Taro's report. A leader can screen the patients, stagger the movement, or draw attention away from the support line.
details.arrows: Each arrow names a crew. None names a duty, failure condition, or right of refusal.

story_overlays.relief_order_screen: The relief detail forms a patient screen and crosses as one visible body.
story_overlays.relief_order_stagger: The relief detail staggers movement so Report and Support can verify each interval.
story_overlays.relief_order_feint: The leader draws patrol attention while Report times the support line through the opposite edge.

rooms.title: Fever Shelter Annex
rooms.description: Old utility walls hold a small fever shelter beyond the disputed lane. Cots, clean-water drums, and hand-written intake cards turn a forgotten service room into public refuge without a permanent flag.

details.cots: The patients can rest here without signing away future movement or allegiance.
details.role ledger: The temporary role ledger has spaces for the report source, the leader's order, the support outcome, and the exact moment authority expires.

story_overlays.patients_moved_without_claim: The fever patients are inside. No role in the temporary detail became ownership of a person, road, or future decision.
story_overlays.relief_detail_complete: The role ledger records completion and expiration. Leader, Report, and Support return to ordinary standing.
story_overlays.report_reliability_active: Two movement slates describe the same cart with different timestamps. Neither has authority until its limits are verified.

rooms.title: Relay Verification Bay
rooms.description: A municipal relay bay survives beneath patched shielding. Its tables compare source stamps, arrival times, and copied signal paths without pretending that a clean format makes a report true.

details.duplicate slates: Both slates describe one neutral resupply cart. The direct slate is fresh but incomplete; the repeated slate carries more detail and an older timestamp.
details.stamp table: The table separates observation time, relay time, source count, confidence, scope, and expiration. A blank field remains blank instead of becoming certainty.
details.filter bank: The filter bank can expose copied timing and signal wash. It cannot identify who caused interference without stronger evidence.

story_overlays.report_raw_classified: The slates are separated into raw observation, copied detail, source count, timestamp, and unresolved interference.
story_overlays.report_rule:corroborate: Two independent marks are required before the route can be published as movement guidance.
story_overlays.report_rule:timebox: The guidance will expire at the shortest verified window instead of inheriting the oldest slate’s confidence.
story_overlays.report_rule:quarantine: The duplicated signal is isolated until the interference is marked and the dispatch gate receives a hold notice.

rooms.title: Dead Signal Cut
rooms.description: The service trench below the relay is quiet enough to hear the repeaters click out of sequence. A washed band erases movement for several counts, then returns the same cart twice.

details.washed band: The gap is deliberate enough to mark as interference, but not clear enough to name an attacker, faction, or motive.
details.echo path: One repeater copies a prior movement trace into the current window. Unmarked, the echo could become a false second source.
details.cut wall: Old public-service markings warn that missing data must be reported as missing, never filled from expectation.

story_overlays.report_interference_marked: The washed band and copied echo are visible on the report. Their origin remains unclaimed and unproven.

rooms.title: Neutral Dispatch Gate
rooms.description: A narrow gate controls when relief carts leave the clinic roads. The dispatch board accepts guidance only when source, scope, confidence, expiration, and known interference are visible together.

details.dispatch board: The board can publish a corroborated route, a short expiring window, or a hold notice. It cannot turn guidance into ownership of the cart or road.
details.resupply cart: The cart waits behind the line with sealed water, fever cloth, and no faction colors.
details.report ledger: The ledger records what moved, what did not, why the decision was made, and when permission to use the report ended.
details.interpretation gallery: A public review gallery opens east after report authority closes. It compares how different disciplines read one verified fact without turning inference into evidence.

story_overlays.report_guidance_published: The dispatch board shows the chosen guidance beside its confidence, interference mark, and expiration.
story_overlays.report_reliability_complete: The report ledger is closed. The cart remains neutral, the guidance is historical, and report authority has expired.
story_overlays.class_lens_complete: The public annotation has closed. Its class lens remains historical, while permission to direct movement has expired.

rooms.title: Neutral Interpretation Gallery
rooms.description: Fifteen narrow panels surround a public table. Each panel names a different discipline, but all face the same sealed movement slate. Iven Rook waits beside three empty headings: FACT, INFERENCE, and UNKNOWN.

details.fifteen panels: The panels reflect the fifteen established class disciplines. None can change the timestamp, route, or source status recorded on the sealed slate.
details.sealed movement slate: The verified record states that one neutral resupply cart moved east during the accepted window. The copied echo remains excluded.
details.three headings: FACT contains what the evidence directly supports. INFERENCE contains a class-informed reading. UNKNOWN contains every conclusion the record cannot support.

story_overlays.class_lens_active: The sealed signal is open for disciplined interpretation, not revision.
story_overlays.class_lens_read: One class lens is visible beside the unchanged verified fact.
story_overlays.class_lens_complete: The review table is closed. The fifteen panels remain as teaching tools, not active authority.

rooms.title: Three-Trace Walk
rooms.description: A short covered walk holds three physical traces from the report chain: the direct timestamp punch, the copied echo casing, and the damaged filter mesh. The route forces interpretation to meet its own review condition.

details.direct timestamp punch: Its mark belongs to the accepted direct observation. Age can weaken usefulness without changing what the mark originally recorded.
details.copied echo casing: Its detail is derived, not independent. No class lens can promote it into a second source.
details.damaged filter mesh: It confirms degraded signal integrity. It does not identify a culprit, faction, motive, or hostile act.

story_overlays.class_truth_separated: The three traces are arranged under fact, inference, and unknown.
story_overlays.class_lens_reviewed: The chosen class lens now carries a visible condition that requires review.

rooms.title: Review Condition Overlook
rooms.description: The overlook faces the road without following the cart. A mechanical board can label the signal VERIFIED, DEGRADED, or REVIEW REQUIRED, but it has no tracking feed and no authority to issue orders.

details.integrity board: VERIFIED means the bounded fact remains supported. DEGRADED means known interference exists. REVIEW REQUIRED means age, route change, source conflict, or repeated interference has crossed the declared limit.
details.empty road: The cart is no longer under observation. Absence of a live feed prevents the lesson from becoming surveillance.
details.review bell: The bell marks when an annotation must be reconsidered; it does not summon a Commander or assign faction authority.

story_overlays.class_lens_reviewed: The board shows the lens beside its explicit recheck condition.
story_overlays.class_limits_labeled: Known interference and unresolved unknowns are printed beside the class inference.

rooms.title: Public Annotation Desk
rooms.description: A low public desk accepts one annotation beneath the sealed fact. The form separates class, inference, unknowns, signal state, and review condition before the ledger can close.

details.annotation form: The form cannot alter the verified observation. It can only explain what one class notices, what remains unknown, and when the reading must be reviewed.
details.public seal: The seal certifies transparent limits, not factual supremacy, ownership, guild status, faction membership, or Commander rank.
details.annotation ledger: Closing the ledger expires permission to use this exercise to direct movement. The teaching record remains reviewable.
details.district notice: A public notice offers one shift of neutral relief access toward District 22. The notice grants passage to the public queue, not citizenship, sponsorship, or protection beyond the posted boundary.

story_overlays.class_annotation_published: The class annotation is visible under the unchanged fact with its unknowns and review condition.
story_overlays.class_lens_complete: The interpretation ledger is closed. A new public notice offers one shift of neutral relief passage toward Shaklas in District 22.

rooms.title: Neutral Route Survey
rooms.description: A public survey table faces the distant Central District walls. Mera Vell has pinned one verified access notice beside fifteen class cautions and three preparation forms: ACCESS, WITNESS, and FALLBACK.

details.access notice: District 22’s Shaklas public relief passage is open for one shift. Neutral travelers may reach the public queue without faction sponsorship.
details.fifteen cautions: Each class caution names what its discipline would watch. None changes the posted access window or proves what lies beyond the queue.
details.preparation forms: ACCESS declares purpose and refusal limits. WITNESS records posted terms and material changes. FALLBACK marks a reversible return route.

story_overlays.district_passage_active: The one-shift passage is open for preparation, not ownership.
story_overlays.district_caution_read: The selected class caution is visible beside the unchanged access notice.
story_overlays.district22_public_access_complete: The survey records one completed neutral passage. No faction seal was added.

rooms.title: Central District Wall-Sight Causeway
rooms.description: A raised causeway brings the fortified Central District walls into view. Public arrows point toward Shaklas while uniformed routes split away toward controlled gates.

details.fortified walls: The walls preserve limited order for those admitted inside. They do not make every district equally safe or every checkpoint impartial.
details.public arrows: The arrows identify a relief passage to District 22. Their paint can prove the posted route, not who controls every block beyond it.
details.return marker: A neutral marker points back to the survey table. Any preparation may use it before the public boundary is crossed.

story_overlays.district_preparation_selected: Your selected preparation is posted beside the one-shift access window.
story_overlays.district_window_verified: The access window, public arrows, and return marker agree at this moment.

rooms.title: District 22, Shaklas Outer Steps
rooms.description: Concrete steps descend between patched walls toward Shaklas. A public boundary post separates the relief route from side streets whose terms remain unverified.

details.public boundary post: The post grants one passage to the public queue during the verified shift. It grants no faction membership, residency, ownership, or authority over other travelers.
details.side streets: The side streets are outside the verified passage. Their tolls, safety, and control remain unknown.
details.patched walls: The repairs show that Shaklas survives through repeated local work even while the wider Central District system protects other areas more visibly.
details.name record: The public post reads SHAKLAS, matching the original player-area charter for District 22. A surviving gang record separately spells SAKLAS; no complete map proves that every use named identical boundaries.

story_overlays.district_window_verified: The boundary post still matches the verified notice.
story_overlays.district_boundary_crossed: Your preparation remains visible as you enter the public passage.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_fallback_tested: The neutral fallback reaches the public outer steps without entering side streets or assigning an escort.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_method_applied: A public source line travels with the replacement part, but no supplier title, sponsorship, schedule control, or side-street authority follows it.

rooms.title: District 22, Shaklas Public Queue
rooms.description: A long public queue bends through a slum courtyard beneath the Central District walls. Relief clerks record purpose, changing conditions, and return routes without promising what happens deeper in Shaklas.

details.public queue: The queue is a shared access point, not proof that the district is governed fairly or safely.
details.relief ledger: The ledger records passage method, visible changes, and expiration. It does not assign citizenship, faction sponsorship, or permanent access.
details.deeper shaklas: Beyond the public queue, District 22 remains largely unmapped. Future movement requires new evidence and a new decision.
details.memory board: A public board east of the queue preserves prior shift marks, erased positions, and the rule that clinical urgency belongs to hospice staff rather than the crowd.
details.name record: The public post reads SHAKLAS, matching the original player-area charter for District 22. A surviving gang record separately spells SAKLAS; no complete map proves that every use named identical boundaries.
details.signal annex: A new public notice points upward to a neutral signal annex. Access opens only after the live-route review closes.

story_overlays.district_boundary_crossed: The public ledger waits to close one neutral passage.
story_overlays.district22_public_access_complete: The passage is historical. Permission and route authority expired at the ledger.
story_overlays.shaklas_queue_review_active: Two service claims share one public marker. The queue will not erase either claim until the review closes.
story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_cost_complete: The threshold exercise is closed. A new public notice explains that the cell’s safe allowance has expired without naming an owner.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_complete: The borrowed-light stewardship is historical. Repair, sharing, and fallback authority have expired.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_terms_active: Kessa has opened one bounded review of a supplier offer without accepting sponsorship, title, or clinical authority.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_terms_complete: The supplier-offer review is historical. Source acknowledgement remains public; every temporary influence and review permission expired.
story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_active: Kessa has opened one live-route review after a copied waymark lost its observation time and expiration.
story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_complete: The live-route method is closed; public guidance remains bounded to its verified window.
story_overlays.journey_11_20_active: A bounded echo review is active above the queue; no one has granted faction, guild, or route ownership authority.

rooms.title: Shaklas Queue Memory Board
rooms.description: A covered board stands inside the public-queue footprint. Paper numbers, chalk witness marks, and cold-cell receipts preserve how people entered the line before a shift-change overwrite attached two claims to one marker.

details.paper numbers: The paper sequence proves that one household held a place before the current shift. It does not prove medical priority or why the marker vanished.
details.chalk witness marks: Two residents independently marked the same earlier position. Their marks support queue history without exposing patient names or destinations.
details.cold-cell receipt: A neutral carrier received temperature-controlled supplies during the current window. The receipt proves a current service claim, not the right to displace the earlier one.
details.erased marker: The board confirms an overwrite during shift change. Culprit, intent, and whether the change was accidental remain unknown.
details.name record: The public post reads SHAKLAS, matching the original player-area charter for District 22. A surviving gang record separately spells SAKLAS; no complete map proves that every use named identical boundaries.

story_overlays.shaklas_queue_memory_read: The board displays two legitimate claims and one missing explanation.
story_overlays.shaklas_queue_sources_traced: Paper, witness, and cold-chain evidence are separated by source and time.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Witness Rail
rooms.description: A waist-high rail keeps the review visible to the queue while protecting the hospice intake from crowd pressure. Public memory can be heard here without turning every resident into a permanent informant.

details.witness slots: Each slot accepts a bounded statement about queue position, time, and visible change. Patient identity, diagnosis, faction, and side-street destination are excluded.
details.method cards: RECONCILE restores the supported history. WITNESS publishes the supported history. HOLD preserves both claims until authorized clinical review.
details.public rail: Everyone can see the rule being used. No one at the rail receives permanent authority over the queue.

story_overlays.shaklas_queue_history_compared: Earlier shelter, caravan, report, and passage methods are visible as precedent, not command.
story_overlays.shaklas_queue_method_selected: One temporary review method is posted beside the unchanged claims.

rooms.title: Shaklas Protected Review Lane
rooms.description: Two painted positions run side by side toward the hospice threshold. The lane exists so neither claim must disappear while the public process is checked.

details.paired positions: The earlier queue place and current cold-chain claim remain distinct. Keeping both visible is not a promise that both will receive the same clinical outcome.
details.shift clock: The review is valid only during the posted public-service window. It must be rechecked if the shift closes or intake capacity changes.
details.stop line: Beyond this line, a hospice worker—not the player, a faction, or the crowd—sets medical priority.

story_overlays.shaklas_queue_window_verified: The paired positions, shift clock, and hospice threshold agree for this review.
story_overlays.shaklas_queue_resolution_applied: Both claims remain visible for authorized clinical review.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Hospice Intake
rooms.description: The public face of the hospice is cleaner than the surrounding courtyard, its walls repeatedly repaired and its intake window deliberately narrow. Milo Fen receives claims here without revealing conditions deeper inside District 22.

details.intake window: Hospice staff decide clinical urgency. The public review protects access to that decision; it does not replace the decision.
details.clean wall: The maintained surface contrasts with the surrounding slum courtyard. The source of that maintenance is not claimed by this route.
details.closure ledger: The ledger records method, preserved claims, review boundary, and expiration. It grants no residency, sponsorship, queue office, or deeper access.
details.name record: The public post reads SHAKLAS, matching the original player-area charter for District 22. A surviving gang record separately spells SAKLAS; no complete map proves that every use named identical boundaries.

story_overlays.shaklas_queue_resolution_applied: Milo waits to receive both preserved claims for clinical review.
story_overlays.shaklas_queue_memory_complete: The public review is historical. Queue authority and service permission have expired.

rooms.title: Shaklas Hospice Public Threshold
rooms.description: A narrow public threshold separates the hospice intake from its nonclinical support equipment. One aging public cell powers a privacy screen, a receipt seal, and return beacons—but never the isolated clinical systems beyond the staff line.

details.public cell: The aging cell supports only three public functions: privacy screen, receipt seal, and return beacons. Clinical systems are isolated from it.
details.staff line: Beyond the line, hospice staff set clinical priority and operate medical systems. The player, Sol, the queue, and every faction remain outside that authority.
details.load plate: Three indicators show the cost of keeping all public functions active at once. The plate proves strain, not failure, sabotage, donor identity, or medical shortage.

story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_cost_active: Milo has opened one bounded review of the public threshold load.
story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_load_read: The load plate separates public support demand from isolated clinical systems.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Capacity Gallery
rooms.description: Three transparent panels show how one public cell can support the threshold without pretending that capacity is free. Each method preserves privacy, accountable receipt, and a reversible way back to the queue.

details.reserve panel: RESERVE dedicates the public cell for one bounded review window, then releases it. It is simple but consumes the whole public allowance during that interval.
details.rotation panel: ROTATE powers the privacy screen, receipt seal, and return beacons in an announced sequence. It shares capacity but requires disciplined timing.
details.manual panel: MANUAL FALLBACK uses paper privacy screens, a hand-stamped receipt, and human-readable return markers. It preserves the route without cell dependence but costs labor and attention.
details.equal mark: All three methods earn equal progression. The lesson tests explicit cost and reversibility, not a hidden preferred morality.

story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_costs_compared: The panels show reserve, rotate, and manual fallback with visible tradeoffs.
story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_method_selected: One temporary method is posted without changing medical priority or ownership.

rooms.title: Shaklas Return-Beacon Walk
rooms.description: A short covered walk tests whether people can leave the threshold and find the public queue again after the selected capacity method is applied. The route is deliberately readable without surveillance or faction escort.

details.return beacons: The beacons point only to the public queue. They do not track people, reveal patient identity, or grant side-street access.
details.manual markers: Painted arrows and numbered ties remain usable if the public cell is unavailable.
details.test line: The route must be walked before closure. A theoretical fallback is not a proven fallback.

story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_return_verified: The selected method still leaves a visible and reversible route to the queue.
story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_method_applied: The public threshold uses the selected temporary capacity method.
story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_return_tested: The route has been exercised rather than merely promised.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Return Gate
rooms.description: A plain gate returns directly to the public queue. It closes the temporary threshold exercise without granting residency, hospice office, faction sponsorship, or a route deeper into District 22.

details.queue arrow: The arrow points south to the same public queue used on entry.
details.expiration plate: Threshold authority ends when Kessa closes the return ledger. The method may inform later work, but it does not persist as ownership or office.
details.unknown district: Conditions beyond the public queue remain unverified.

story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_return_tested: The exercised route reaches the public return gate.
story_overlays.shaklas_threshold_cost_complete: The threshold lesson is historical and its temporary authority has expired.

rooms.title: Shaklas Borrowed-Light Notice
rooms.description: A public plate below the queue marks the end of the threshold cell’s previous allowance. Its owner line is blank by design: the notice records load, receipts, and expiration without inventing a donor or turning maintenance into title.

details.expiration plate: The prior reserve, rotation, or manual arrangement ended cleanly. Continuing service requires a new bounded decision.
details.blank owner line: No donor, installer, faction, repairer, or payer is named as owner. The absence is not evidence of abandonment.
details.output trace: The public cell may support another bounded shift only through disclosed repair, explicit sharing, or deliberate rest. The trace says nothing about clinical systems.

story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_active: Kessa has opened one temporary review of the expired public allowance.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_expiration_read: The notice separates expiration from failure, sabotage, donor identity, and ownership.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_terms_active: A supplier crate waits below the notice. Its useful part and its continuing influence claims must be read separately.

rooms.title: Shaklas Open Parts Bench
rooms.description: A transparent bench displays one coupler, a public salvage receipt, a shift clock, and a cooling latch. Davin Quist uses the bench to compare three forms of stewardship without crossing the hospice staff line.

details.repair tray: OPEN REPAIR uses declared public salvage, publishes the work receipt, verifies output, and gives no title to the repairer or payer.
details.share clock: SHARED WINDOW divides one shift among public functions with visible times, refusal rights, and automatic expiration.
details.cooling latch: REST AND REDIRECT pauses electronic convenience while manual privacy, accountable receipt, and a neutral fallback carry the public load.
details.equal mark: All three methods grant equal progression. The choice records cost and boundary, not a hidden preferred morality.

story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_claims_traced: Parts, time, public functions, and the blank ownership line have been traced separately.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_terms_compared: Open repair, shared window, and rest-and-redirect are visible with distinct costs.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_method_selected: One temporary method is selected without creating ownership or clinical authority.

rooms.title: Shaklas Neutral Service Turn
rooms.description: A covered public turn links the parts bench to the Shaklas outer steps. Manual privacy panels, a hand-stamp station, and readable route marks keep service reversible when the public cell is repaired, shared, resting, or unavailable.

details.fallback marker: The marker leads only to the public outer steps and queue. It grants no side-street access, residency, sponsorship, or deeper knowledge.
details.manual station: Privacy panels and hand-stamped receipts preserve public support without touching isolated clinical systems.
details.test line: A fallback is not accepted until someone physically follows it and returns to the public queue.

story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_terms_verified: The selected terms include cost, refusal or abort conditions, expiration, and the neutral fallback.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_method_applied: The selected temporary stewardship is active for one declared shift.
story_overlays.shaklas_borrowed_light_fallback_tested: The neutral fallback has been exercised rather than merely promised.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_fallback_tested: The neutral salvage and return route has been exercised independently of the supplier.
story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_expiration_tested: The copied detail has expired or been segmented; only the bounded public record returns to the queue.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Offer Rail
rooms.description: A sealed coupler crate rests beneath a transparent rail. Talin Dorr has listed one useful part beside four proposed side terms: a permanent nameplate, first notice of future failures, preference in later schedules, and access to public failure data.

details.coupler crate: One compatible public-cell coupler is present. Its presence proves supply, not ownership, motive, faction affiliation, or future availability.
details.nameplate proposal: The proposed plate would turn source acknowledgement into a durable public title. Those are different claims.
details.first-notice proposal: First notice of future failures could create informational leverage over later public choices.
details.schedule preference: Preference in later service windows would outlive the current part and convert one transaction into continuing influence.
details.failure-data request: Public performance facts may be published without giving one supplier identity, diagnosis, movement history, or exclusive access.

story_overlays.shaklas_gift_terms_active: The useful part and the four proposed influence claims remain separate on the rail.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_claims_traced: Part, source, price, title, sponsorship, first notice, scheduling, and data access have been traced separately.
story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_scope_active: A copied receipt waits below the offer rail. Its source line survived, but its declared scope and expiration did not.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Terms Table
rooms.description: Three public forms lie under clear panels: an unconditional contribution waiver, a one-price one-shift purchase, and a refusal notice tied to the neutral salvage locker. Each preserves source acknowledgement without manufacturing an owner or sponsor.

details.unconditional form: The part may be accepted only after every side term is waived. Talin remains the acknowledged source and gains no plaque, priority, sponsorship, data right, or future access.
details.purchase form: A neutral public ledger may pay one fixed consideration for one part. Receipt closes the transaction; no future preference survives it.
details.refusal form: The crate and every side term may be declined without blacklisting the queue. Independent salvage is slower and openly recorded.
details.equal mark: All three methods grant equal progression. The choice records how influence was bounded, not which morality the game prefers.

story_overlays.shaklas_gift_terms_compared: Contribution, purchase, and refusal are visible with source, consideration, refusal, expiry, and fallback separated.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_method_selected: One method is selected; no side term becomes valid until refusal and fallback are verified.

rooms.title: Shaklas Neutral Salvage Locker
rooms.description: A public locker contains slower, mismatched salvage that can be adapted without Talin’s crate. A source-line printer and refusal stamp ensure that accepting help, buying a part, and declining influence remain distinct acts.

details.salvage bins: Independent salvage costs time and labor, but it keeps one supplier from becoming a single point of public failure.
details.refusal stamp: The stamp records that the queue may refuse the current crate or any future offer without losing neutral access.
details.source-line printer: A source can be named honestly without granting title, sponsorship, schedule preference, exclusive data, or clinical authority.
details.fallback test: Even after accepting or purchasing the part, the neutral salvage route must be exercised so future service does not depend on one supplier.

story_overlays.shaklas_gift_refusal_verified: Refusal remains available without blacklist, lost queue access, or clinical consequence.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_method_applied: The selected part path is active; its public source line still must be published.
story_overlays.shaklas_gift_source_acknowledged: The source is public, while title, sponsorship, priority, and exclusive data remain absent.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Receipt Copy Rail
rooms.description: A copied public receipt hangs beneath clear clips. Its immediate source and method remain readable, but the declared scope and expiration line were cropped away. No identity, diagnosis, or clinical record appears on the copy.

details.cropped receipt: One copied receipt exists here. The crop proves missing context, not who copied it, why, how many copies exist, or whether any faction has used it.
details.source line: The immediate source path remains visible. A source acknowledgement is not ownership, sponsorship, title, or permission to reuse the record forever.
details.missing scope: The original record applied to one bounded public-cell decision. The copy no longer shows that boundary.
details.missing expiration: A public record may remain accountable without keeping every operational detail permanently active.

story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_scope_active: Nira Kes has opened one bounded review of the copied receipt.
story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_copy_inspected: The surviving fact, cropped context, and unresolved copier are recorded separately.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Receipt Scope Desk
rooms.description: Three public forms separate accountability from uncontrolled reuse: a minimal transaction digest, a time-limited review copy, and a segmented ledger that keeps public facts apart from operational and clinical records.

details.minimal digest: Publish method, immediate source or neutral fallback, declared consideration or refusal, one-shift scope, and expiration—without identity, movement history, diagnosis, or private service detail.
details.time-limited review: Keep the complete public transaction record visible for one announced review window, then replace it with the minimal digest.
details.segmented ledger: Place public transaction facts in one ledger while operational routing and clinical records remain isolated and unlinked.
details.equal mark: All three methods grant equal progression. The lesson records how reuse was bounded, not which answer the game prefers.

story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_methods_compared: Minimal, timeboxed, and segmented publication are visible with the same facts, unknowns, and authority boundary.
story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_method_selected: One publication method is selected; private and clinical separation still must be verified.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Ledger Gate
rooms.description: A public printer, expiration marker, and private-boundary seal stand beside the neutral return route. The gate can preserve transaction accountability without turning a receipt into identity exposure, movement tracking, clinical access, policing, or permanent influence.

details.public printer: The printer accepts only bounded public facts: method, immediate source or fallback, consideration or refusal, scope, and expiration.
details.private-boundary seal: Names of service recipients, diagnoses, clinical priority, movement histories, and private operational notes remain outside the public receipt.
details.expiration marker: The selected detail either expires, reduces to a digest, or remains separated at the end of the declared review window.
