details.unknown-copy notice: The copier, motive, number of copies, route beyond this rail, faction involvement, and any later use remain unknown.

story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_private_boundary_verifie: Public accountability and private or clinical records have been separated.
story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_scope_published: The selected bounded receipt has been published with scope and expiration restored.
story_overlays.shaklas_receipt_expiration_tested: The review window ended as declared; no continuing copy authority survived.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Index Board
rooms.description: A public index summarizes completed service work in short, reusable lines. One entry calls the public-cell repair “sponsored restoration,” even though the bounded source ledger records no sponsor, title, permanent access, or continuing authority.

details.sponsored restoration: The phrase appears in the derived public index. It is not present in the source transaction ledger and is not established by a contribution, bounded purchase, or refused offer followed by neutral salvage.
details.derived index: The board compresses longer source records. Compression can aid navigation, but a derived label cannot overrule the source that supports it.
details.source pointer: A visible pointer leads back to the bounded supplier and receipt ledgers. The source record remains operative while the index line is reviewed.
details.unknown authorship: The board does not establish who wrote the phrase, why it was written, whether Talin requested it, who relied on it, or whether any harm followed.

story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_active: Aven Quill has opened one bounded review of the unsupported “sponsored restoration” label.
story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_index_inspected: The index label, source pointer, and unresolved authorship are separated in the public record.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Correction Table
rooms.description: Three equal remedies sit beneath clear headings: append a dated correction without erasing the original; issue a corrected edition linked to the superseded line; or place a temporary reliance hold on the unsupported label while the bounded source ledger remains operative.

details.dated correction: Preserve the original index line as evidence, attach a dated correction, and make the source-ledger contradiction visible.
details.corrected edition: Publish a new index edition with a stable link to the superseded wording and the source record that governs the correction.
details.reliance hold: Mark the unsupported label non-operative for one review window without erasing it; the bounded source ledger remains usable.
details.equal mark: All three remedies grant equal progression. The game records the player’s correction doctrine, not a preferred morality.

story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_methods_compared: Annotation, linked correction, and bounded reliance hold are visible with identical facts and unknowns.
story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_method_selected: One remedy is selected; its source boundary still must be verified before publication.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Reliance Gate
rooms.description: A version seal, reliance marker, and return path stand beside the correction table. The gate can publish a bounded correction without converting the reviewer into an owner, censor, sponsor, investigator, faction officer, or permanent record authority.

details.version seal: Every correction names the source ledger, the unsupported phrase, the selected remedy, the date or review window, and the relationship between the old and new line.
details.reliance marker: The marker distinguishes “visible for audit” from “operative for decisions.” It does not declare guilt, intent, or harm.
details.appeal boundary: The review corrects one public index label. It does not rewrite the underlying transaction, erase the original record, identify an author, or control clinical, movement, faction, or access decisions.
details.return path: The west path rejoins the neutral service route. Temporary correction authority must end before the player returns to the public queue.

story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_source_verified: The derived index is subordinate to the bounded source ledger; fact, inference, and unknown are separated.
story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_correction_published: The selected remedy is published without assigning authorship, motive, faction, or harm.
story_overlays.shaklas_appeal_reliance_tested: The original line remains auditable while its operative status follows the selected remedy exactly.

rooms.title: Shaklas Live Waymark
rooms.description: A public waymark copied from the corrected index says the hospice return route is open. The source pointer survives, but the observation time and expiration line do not. A route label can preserve memory; it cannot prove the lane is still safe.

details.open route: The phrase is a copied summary of an earlier public condition. It lacks the observed-at time, review window, and expiration needed to direct current movement.
details.source pointer: The pointer leads to the corrected public index and bounded source ledger. Those records establish what was published, not what the physical lane looks like now.
details.missing time: No visible line states when the route was last walked, when the sign should expire, or what condition would require reinspection.
details.public boundary: The waymark contains no names, clinical details, faction roster, residency list, or permanent access grant.

story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_active: Jorin Pell keeps the copied waymark visible while its live condition and missing time boundary are reviewed.
story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_waymark_inspected: The copied route claim, surviving source pointer, missing observation time, and unresolved copier are separated.

rooms.title: Shaklas Route Survey Span
rooms.description: A narrow public span overlooks the return lane without exposing the side streets below. Three equal practices are posted here: publish a one-shift waymark after inspection, escort one anonymous cohort and dissolve the detail, or hold the sign non-operative until two local checks agree.

details.timeboxed waymark: Publish only the currently inspected public path, observed-at time, expiration, return option, and condition that forces reinspection.
details.single cohort: Guide one anonymous public group through the verified lane. Keep no roster or movement history, and end escort authority when the last traveler arrives.
details.reliance hold: Leave the sign visible but non-operative until two local checks agree. Preserve a visible return and refusal path while conditions remain uncertain.
details.equal progression: All three methods grant equal progression. The method records a wayfinding doctrine, not a preferred morality or route ownership claim.

story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_methods_compared: Timeboxed guidance, single-cohort escort, and bounded reliance hold remain visible under the same facts and unknowns.
story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_method_selected: One route-safety method is selected; live conditions still must be verified at the fork.

rooms.title: Shaklas Public Route Fork
rooms.description: The main public lane is passable in single file during this inspection. A side stair is closed by a movable debris screen, and the east return gate still opens toward the public steps. No sign here establishes who shifted the screen or what conditions exist deeper in Shaklas.

details.main lane: The currently inspected lane is passable in single file. That observation is local and time-bounded, not a promise of future safety.
details.side stair: A movable debris screen closes the side stair. Its mover, purpose, ownership, and future position are not established.
details.return gate: The east gate opens toward the known public steps. Every method must preserve a return or refusal option.
details.no roster: Live-route review needs condition evidence, not traveler identity, diagnosis, faction, or residence.

story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_conditions_verified: The main lane, closed side stair, open return gate, observation time, and unresolved cause are recorded separately.
story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_method_applied: The selected route method is active only for its declared public window.
story_overlays.shaklas_wayfinding_boundary_tested: The route returns people to the public steps without creating a roster, owner, patrol office, or permanent access pass.

rooms.title: Shaklas Signal Annex
rooms.description: A neutral archive room holds one copied route packet beneath three headings: SOURCE, CURRENT EVIDENCE, and UNKNOWN. Nyra Kint has left every identity field blank until a person chooses what can be public.

details.echo packet: The packet contains a valid source pointer and an old route pulse. It does not establish who sent it, why, or whether its path remains safe.
details.three headings: Source, current evidence, and unknowns remain separate so a useful signal cannot become a verdict.
details.five-point protocol: A later field protocol uses ordinary sensory checks. It is not the canonical seven-gate method and does not define limiter ontology.

story_overlays.journey_echo_review_active: The old packet is being reviewed without accepting its identities, ownership claims, or unstated mechanism.

rooms.title: Public Signal Ramp
rooms.description: A sloped public return connects the annex to District 8 fringe infrastructure. Every handrail carries a visible return marker so review can end without becoming detention or forced travel.

details.return markers: Each marker points back to the Shaklas public queue and carries an expiration time.
details.no manifest: The ramp records condition and timing, not traveler names or destinations.

story_overlays.journey_echo_scope_set: The first echo review has a source boundary, current-evidence boundary, unknown list, and safe return.

rooms.title: District 8 Fringe Exchange
rooms.description: A public exchange at the edge of District 8 translates route packets into anonymous time windows. Halen Tor removes names before any coordinate can direct movement.

details.identity sieve: The sieve can remove names, faces, medical details, faction tags, and long-lived device identifiers while retaining a bounded interval.
details.equal methods: Cohort hash, public interval, and local witness produce equal progression and no permanent roster.

story_overlays.people_before_coordinates_active: One identity-minimization method is being compared without treating privacy as disappearance.

rooms.title: Echo Concourse
rooms.description: Old transit repeaters face a dark branch line and a sealed resonance platform. Daro Nix keeps one receiver open only long enough to compare an incoming frequency with the physical relay that claims to carry it.

details.ownerless frequency: The frequency is observable. Its author, owner, purpose, and relationship to the player remain unspecified.
details.dead branch: A north branch contains stripped relay hardware and a scavenger frame.
details.resonance platform: The east platform is safe for baseline work only after the dead-channel source is checked.

story_overlays.frequency_without_owner_active: The signal is being tested as evidence without assigning it a speaker, faction, or supernatural explanation.

rooms.title: Dead Channel Alley
rooms.description: A maintenance alley ends at a relay cabinet whose owner plate has been removed. A scavenger frame strips every unclassified packet for parts while the original source line remains unreadable.

details.relay cabinet: The cabinet proves local reuse and physical damage. It does not identify the original sender.
details.cut line: A manual cut line can preserve the packet after the scavenger is stopped.

story_overlays.dead_channel_coil_recovered: The surviving coil is tagged as an ownerless field artifact rather than claimed as a message from a known person.

rooms.title: Resonance Platform
rooms.description: Five ordinary reference stations surround a dormant transit repeater: sightline, sound, touch, balance, and self-orientation. Sol stands within reach but outside the instrument circle.

details.five references: The protocol uses ordinary sensory anchors to detect disagreement between body and signal. It is not the canonical seven-gate sequence.
details.dormant repeater: The repeater holds transition-like residue, but the game does not identify whether it comes from limiters, Between Worlds, reconstruction, or another cause.
details.safe return: The west route remains physically open throughout calibration.

story_overlays.first_anchor_ready: A bounded baseline is ready; opening the repeater may expose a new cost.
story_overlays.sensorium_echo_active: The player’s present senses and the relay echo disagree. The mechanism remains unspecified.

rooms.title: Sight Anchor Gallery
rooms.description: Offset panels repeat one movement a fraction late. The safest line is not the brightest image but the one confirmed by body position, Sol’s independent witness, and the fixed return rail.

details.offset panels: Each panel is deliberately late. The player must identify the live sightline rather than attack every copy.
details.return rail: A fixed physical rail leads west even when the images disagree.

story_overlays.sight_anchor_complete: The live sightline is recorded as a present check, not a permanent truth.

rooms.title: Sound Anchor Tunnel
rooms.description: Three relay tones arrive from different distances. One is live, one is a copied echo, and one is a safety pulse generated locally. No tone is permitted to name a speaker without evidence.

details.live tone: The live tone matches local delay and hardware position.
details.copied echo: The copy is real data but lacks current time and speaker identity.
details.safety pulse: The local pulse is intentionally generated and labeled.

story_overlays.sound_anchor_complete: Live tone, copied echo, and local safety pulse remain separately labeled.

rooms.title: Touch Anchor Workshop
rooms.description: Weighted grips, textured plates, and a manual cut switch provide physical references that no remote packet can quietly rewrite. An illegal timing emitter hums behind a raider’s shield.

details.weighted grip: The grip confirms pressure and position without identifying the origin of the echo.
details.manual cut switch: The switch can isolate local instruments from the relay.
details.timing emitter: The emitter changes cue timing. Its builder and upstream source remain unknown.

story_overlays.touch_anchor_complete: The player has a physical reference and an independently tested local cut switch.

rooms.title: Balance Anchor Span
rooms.description: A narrow span tilts in predictable increments while the relay projects misleading horizon lines. The exercise rewards controlled movement, not speed, and keeps a westward withdrawal open.

details.tilt sequence: The span announces each physical tilt before it moves.
details.false horizon: Projected lines disagree with the announced movement and must not be trusted alone.
details.withdrawal: The west route remains open and visible.

rooms.hazard_text: The span tilts underfoot. A slow stance or sensory anchor prevents the false horizon from stealing your footing.

story_overlays.balance_anchor_complete: The physical tilt sequence is distinguished from the projected horizon.

rooms.title: Identity Anchor Chamber
rooms.description: A quiet chamber asks for no secret memory and no permanent biometric profile. It records only the player’s chosen name, present condition, known companions, current objective, and right to end the test.

details.chosen name: The chamber accepts the name the player uses now. It does not decide continuity of consciousness or ownership of the reconstructed body.
details.present condition: Current wounds and sensory disagreement are recorded without inventing a diagnosis.
details.exit right: The west route remains open; the test can end without penalty.

story_overlays.identity_anchor_complete: The self-map records present choices and boundaries without claiming a complete theory of identity.
story_overlays.sensorium_echo_rehabilitated: The active phase-lag penalty has cleared; the uncertainty remains documented.

rooms.title: Present-Self Feedback Court
rooms.description: A nonclinical training court converts the five local anchors into a delayed-response exercise. Its frame imitates recorded timing only; it does not copy memory, identity, consciousness, or a canonical Between-Worlds self.

details.feedback frame: A public training frame replays bounded timing data from the five anchors. It has no claim to personhood or identity.
details.five references: Sightline, live signal, weighted grip, balance rail, and present self-orientation remain ordinary field references—not the seven gates.
details.return route: The south exit remains visible and usable after the frame yields.

story_overlays.five_anchors_complete: The court tests the player’s present coordination while the sensory echo is still active.

rooms.title: Second Horizon Review Gate
rooms.description: A public departure gate faces a sealed transit horizon. It can certify readiness to study a Beta Earth route, but it cannot promise passage, safety, citizenship, faction sponsorship, or ownership beyond the threshold.

details.sealed horizon: The gate has no active world crossing. It opens only a future expedition review.
details.three methods: Observe-first survey, one bounded escort, or reliance hold all preserve refusal and equal progression.
details.not seven gates: This infrastructure is not one of the canonical seven gates of reality.

story_overlays.second_horizon_method_selected: One departure-review doctrine is selected without granting passage or title.
story_overlays.beta_earth_horizon_ready: The player is ready for a future Beta Earth expedition review; no world crossing is claimed.
story_overlays.field_cohort_notice_accepted: A neutral cohort request is open east of the review gate.

rooms.title: Phase Discipline Lab
rooms.description: A transparent practice room stands outside the dormant repeater circle. Two class pathways are projected without ranking them; a padded frame and repair plate let the player convert a chosen branch into repeatable discipline.

details.two pathways: The lab reads the two authored branches of the current class. It never changes class, faction, or prior specialization without an explicit choice.
details.practice frame: The frame is non-sentient and stores no memory, identity, or traveler record.
details.mastery rail: Three primary-and-follow-up cycles unlock the existing impact-or-tempo mastery decision.

story_overlays.phase_discipline_complete: The selected branch and mastery are recorded without granting rank or faction status.

rooms.title: Present-Tense Overlook
rooms.description: A narrow overlook above the sound-anchor tunnel divides into three clearly marked formations: balanced partnership, guarded recovery, and deliberate assault. Sol waits for the player to choose how they will face the next echo together.

details.balanced line: Sol creates openings and reserves safe finishes for the player.
details.guard line: Sol protects recovery and withdrawal while dealing no direct damage.
details.assault line: Sol applies maximum pressure and may take a finishing strike only after explicit player authorization.
details.present marker: The exercise asks what the pair choose now; it does not reveal or alter Sol’s later canonical fate.

story_overlays.partner_synchrony_active: A bounded partner-order review is active.
story_overlays.partner_synchrony_complete: The chosen formation was exercised under live echo pressure and remains player-controlled.

rooms.title: Second Horizon Relief Apron
rooms.description: A broad public apron outside the sealed horizon holds three painted formation lanes—balanced, offensive, and defensive—without assigning names to the neutral travelers waiting beyond the privacy screens. Sera Vann keeps the route terms visible and temporary.

details.balanced lane: A mixed formation protects movement, support, and measured pressure without ranking one role above another.
details.offensive lane: A pressure-forward formation creates room quickly but accepts less defensive redundancy.
details.defensive lane: A shelter-forward formation layers protection and recovery while accepting slower progress.
details.privacy screens: The cohort remains anonymous. No names, diagnoses, factions, destinations, or permanent identifiers are collected.

story_overlays.field_cohort_detail_active: A bounded neutral-cohort detail is active.
story_overlays.field_cohort_detail_complete: The temporary detail has closed and every role has expired.

rooms.title: Echo Cohort Crossing
rooms.description: A low transit cut carries old route pulses across broken mirror panels. Anonymous passage tokens mark only the current headcount and refusal path. A non-sentient pursuit frame can be released here to test the chosen formation and the player’s synchrony with Sol.

details.anonymous tokens: The tokens carry a temporary count and return direction, not identity, medical status, faction, or future destination.
details.pursuit rail: The rail releases a padded non-sentient frame. It records no memory, consciousness, or traveler profile.
details.return arrow: The west path remains open until the detail closes.

story_overlays.field_cohort_sync_ready: The pursuit frame is ready for a player-triggered Sol synchronization maneuver.
story_overlays.field_cohort_frame_defeated: The route is clear to the public shelter.

rooms.title: Second Horizon Public Return Shelter
rooms.description: A neutral shelter receives the cohort without converting arrival into residency, ownership, recruitment, or a future movement record. A public ledger records only that the bounded detail ended and its temporary authority expired.

details.arrival ledger: The ledger records one completed crossing, the selected formation, and expiration. It contains no traveler identities.
details.open return: Travelers retain the right to leave or refuse future details.
details.blank ownership line: No faction, guild, leader, or route owner is entered.

story_overlays.field_cohort_arrived: The neutral cohort reached shelter without becoming a roster.
story_overlays.field_cohort_detail_complete: Temporary detail, report, and formation authority have expired.

rooms.title: Second Horizon Public Witness Station
rooms.description: A small neutral station compares current field observations without turning a temporary report into permanent authority. Three lamps separate confirmed fact, bounded inference, and unknown information. Sol waits beside the return board rather than speaking for the player.

details.fact lamp: Records only what was directly observed during the current crossing.
details.inference lamp: Allows a bounded interpretation while preserving uncertainty.
details.unknown lamp: Keeps missing identity, motive, faction, diagnosis, and future-route claims blank.
details.return board: Every temporary report shows its expiration and an ordinary route back.

rooms.title: Expired Order Gallery
rooms.description: A narrow review gallery displays copied orders whose signatures, scope, or time limits no longer agree. The player must decide what can be disclosed, redacted, or held rather than obeying a label that merely looks official.

details.copied order: The destination line is legible, but issuer identity and current authority do not verify.
details.scope seal: The seal authorizes one past movement window and has already expired.
details.public pane: The pane accepts a disclosed, redacted, or held packet with equal progression.

rooms.title: Counter-Signal Chamber
rooms.description: A shielded public test chamber where copied distress pulses can be challenged without touching a live route. Three response stations preserve force, care, and uncertainty as separate choices.

rooms.title: Echo Return Balcony
rooms.description: A quiet balcony above the repeater line. Every temporary response token dissolves here, leaving only the player’s chosen lesson and an open road back.

rooms.title: Consent Archive
rooms.description: A public archive places expired choices beside new requests without merging them. Every request shows person, purpose, action, time, and exit as separate fields.

rooms.title: Scope Release Walk
rooms.description: A short open-air walk where current permissions visibly narrow and expire. Nothing here can preserve a hidden command after the player leaves.
